Article 10 (Authorized Number of Military Attachés)
(1) The authorized number of military attachés shall be as specified in the attached Table. The Minister of National Defense shall manage that number within the limits prescribed by the General Rules on National Defense Organization and Personnel Establishments and relevant statutes or regulations; when changing the authorized number, the Minister shall consult with the Minister of Foreign Affairs and the Minister of Planning and Budget. <Amended on March 23, 2013; September 19, 2017; December 30, 2025>
(2) When allocating or changing the number of military attachés assigned to each diplomatic mission abroad within the authorized number under paragraph (1), the Minister of National Defense shall consult with the Minister of Foreign Affairs. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
